description: Registry of the desktop-assessment sources used to build an Environmental Site Summary (ESS). Consumed by both the browser tool (assets/app.js) and the ess-collect skill. Add a source = add an object to `sources`; see docs/ADDING-A-SOURCE.md.

placeholders.{lat}: site latitude (decimal, negative for southern hemisphere)
placeholders.{state}: state/territory code (QLD, NSW, VIC, TAS, ACT, WA, NT, SA)
placeholders.{lat_min}: south edge of the auto-computed bounding box
placeholders.{lat_max}: north edge of the auto-computed bounding box
placeholders.{lon_min}: west edge of the auto-computed bounding box
placeholders.{lon_max}: east edge of the auto-computed bounding box

categories.label: Indigenous Protected Areas and Heritage
categories.proforma_section: Indigenous Protected Areas and Heritage at the Site

sources.name: EPBC Protected Matters Search Tool (PMST)
sources.what_to_find: Matters of National Environmental Significance within a 50 km buffer of the site: protected areas (terrestrial & marine), Ramsar wetlands, World/National/Commonwealth heritage places, Great Barrier Reef Marine Park, Australian Marine Parks and listed critical habitat.
sources.instructions: 1) Locate the site (lat/long is most specific). 2) LHS menu > Draw > draw a square around the location. 3) LHS menu > Report > select box 1. 4) Buffer = 50 km > Explore. 5) Generate report (bottom RHS) as Excel (easiest to sort by known/likely and IUCN status) or PDF. Record the matters returned against the categories in `epbc_matters`.
sources.no_result_means: No matters of national environmental significance were returned for the buffer.

sources.name: Atlas of Living Australia
sources.what_to_find: Occurrence records of flora & fauna within the radius, filtered to those carrying a state or national conservation status (threatened / vulnerable / endangered). Use to corroborate and prioritise the PMST result.
sources.no_result_means: No conservation-listed occurrence records fall within the search radius (does not rule out cryptic/unsurveyed species).

sources.name: BOM Permits, Licences & Authorisations Register
sources.what_to_find: Whether an existing permit covers this site, or a permit must be obtained before visiting. Also flag Indigenous Land Council permission if applicable.
sources.instructions: Internal SharePoint. Check the permits register for an entry matching this station / area.

sources.name: Property on a Page (POPE) & Leasing files
sources.what_to_find: Lease conditions that impose biosecurity or access obligations (washdown, declarations, restricted entry).
sources.instructions: Internal SharePoint (Property Services > Leasing Team Public Files). You may need to request access. Cross-check lease conditions before setting the biosecurity level.

sources.name: Indigenous Protected Areas (DCCEEW)
sources.what_to_find: Whether the site falls within a declared Indigenous Protected Area.

sources.name: NIAA Land and Sea Management Projects map
sources.what_to_find: Indigenous land & sea management projects overlapping or adjacent to the site.

sources.name: Australian Heritage Database
sources.what_to_find: World, National, Commonwealth, Register of the National Estate and overseas heritage listings at or near the site. Double-checks the PMST heritage result.

sources.name: Bureau Heritage Register / Handbook
sources.what_to_find: Whether this Bureau site is on the internal Heritage Register (useful double-check).

sources.name: DCCEEW Invasive Species (national overview)
sources.what_to_find: National context for invasive animals. Combine with state agency & local council information.

sources.name: OUTBREAK – Animal & Plant Pest and Disease
sources.what_to_find: Current pest/disease outbreaks or control/movement zones affecting the area (e.g. fire ants, varroa, foot-and-mouth preparedness).

sources.name: Australian PFAS Chemicals Map
sources.what_to_find: Known or investigated PFAS contamination sites near the location (especially airports, defence and fire-training grounds).

sources.name: Atlas of Australian Acid Sulfate Soils (CSIRO/ASRIS)
sources.what_to_find: Probability of acid sulfate soils at the site (relevant to any ground disturbance).

sources.name: Soil Health Knowledge Base
sources.what_to_find: General soil characteristics for the locality.

sources.name: General locality search (council / parks / news)
sources.what_to_find: Anything the federal/state tools missed: local council pest declarations, national park info, tourism/wiki notes, past land use (rubbish dumps), known incursions (fire ants, phytophthora).
sources.web_search: {name} {state} environment weeds pests heritage national park

sources.name: Map view (locality context)
sources.what_to_find: Visual context: proximity to waterways, wetlands, parks, airports, urban/rural interface.

sources.name: Queensland Globe
sources.what_to_find: State environmental, vegetation, wetland and cadastral layers around the site.

sources.name: QLD WetlandMaps
sources.what_to_find: Mapped wetlands and their significance at the site.

sources.name: QLD BioMaps
sources.what_to_find: Biodiversity, essential habitat and wildlife records for the area.

sources.name: QLD Protected Plants Flora Survey Trigger Map
sources.what_to_find: Whether the site falls in a high-risk (trigger) area for protected plants, which would require a flora survey.

sources.name: QLD Regional Ecosystem descriptions
sources.what_to_find: Regional ecosystem classification and vegetation-management status at the site.

sources.name: QLD WildNet species search
sources.what_to_find: Species records (including conservation-significant) for the locality.

sources.name: Queensland Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: State heritage-listed places at or near the site.

sources.name: NSW Planning Portal Spatial Viewer
sources.what_to_find: Planning, biodiversity and land-use layers for the site.

sources.name: NSW BioNet
sources.what_to_find: Threatened species, populations and ecological communities recorded in the area.

sources.name: PlantNET (NSW FloraOnline)
sources.what_to_find: NSW flora identification and distribution.

sources.name: NSW Native Vegetation Regulatory Map
sources.what_to_find: Regulated native vegetation categories affecting any clearing.

sources.name: NSW Heritage database search
sources.what_to_find: State Heritage Register and other NSW heritage listings near the site.

sources.name: NatureKit Victoria
sources.what_to_find: Modelled and recorded biodiversity values, EVCs and habitat at the site.

sources.name: VIC Native Vegetation Removal Regulations map
sources.what_to_find: Location risk rating and native vegetation removal requirements.

sources.name: VicPlan
sources.what_to_find: Planning zones, overlays (including environmental & heritage) at the site.

sources.name: Victoria Unearthed (contaminated land)
sources.what_to_find: Historical land use and potential contamination (former industrial sites, landfills, gasworks).

sources.name: Victorian Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: State heritage-listed places near the site.

sources.name: LISTmap (Land Information System Tasmania)
sources.what_to_find: Natural values, reserves, vegetation and cadastral layers at the site.

sources.name: Tasmanian Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: State heritage-listed places near the site.

sources.name: ACT Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: ACT heritage-listed places near the site.

sources.name: PlanWA (DPLH)
sources.what_to_find: Planning, environmental and land layers for the site.

sources.name: NatureMap (DBCA)
sources.what_to_find: WA flora & fauna records, including threatened species, for the area.

sources.name: Dandjoo (Biodiversity Information Office)
sources.what_to_find: Consolidated WA biodiversity data for the location.

sources.name: data.wa.gov.au (Environment datasets)
sources.what_to_find: Relevant WA environmental datasets for deeper checks.

sources.name: WA Aboriginal Cultural Heritage Inquiry System (ACHIS)
sources.what_to_find: Registered Aboriginal sites and heritage places near the location.

sources.name: Locate (SLIP / Landgate)
sources.what_to_find: Location context and additional WA spatial layers.

sources.name: inHerit (WA State Heritage Office)
sources.what_to_find: WA (non-Aboriginal) heritage-listed places near the site.

sources.name: NT Atlas and Spatial Data Directory
sources.what_to_find: NT environmental, vegetation and land layers at the site.

sources.name: NR Maps (NT)
sources.what_to_find: Natural resource, vegetation and conservation layers around the site.

sources.name: NT Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: NT heritage-listed places or objects near the site.

sources.name: SAPPA (SA Property and Planning Atlas)
sources.what_to_find: Planning, overlays and land information for the site.

sources.name: NatureMaps (SA)
sources.what_to_find: SA flora & fauna records, threatened species and conservation areas at the site.

sources.name: SA Native Vegetation Clearance information
sources.what_to_find: Native vegetation clearance obligations relevant to any works.

sources.name: SA Heritage Register
sources.what_to_find: SA state heritage places near the site.

sources.name: QLD restricted invasive plants (Business Queensland)
sources.what_to_find: State-declared / restricted invasive plants relevant to the area. Cross-check local council pest declarations.
sources.web_search: restricted invasive weeds {name} QLD local council

sources.name: NSW WeedWise / regional weeds
sources.what_to_find: Priority weeds for the NSW region containing the site. Cross-check local council pest declarations.

sources.name: VIC weeds information (Agriculture Victoria)
sources.what_to_find: Declared noxious weeds for the area. Cross-check local council pest declarations.
sources.web_search: declared noxious weeds {name} Victoria local council

sources.name: SA declared pest plants (Landscape SA)
sources.what_to_find: Declared pest plants for the area. Cross-check local council/landscape board declarations.
sources.web_search: declared pest plants weeds {name} South Australia

sources.name: WA pests, weeds & diseases (DPIRD)
sources.what_to_find: Declared/priority weeds for the area. Cross-check local government pest declarations.

sources.name: TAS declared weeds index (NRE)
sources.what_to_find: Declared weeds for the area. Cross-check local council declarations.

sources.name: NT weeds (NT Government)
sources.what_to_find: Declared weeds for the area. Cross-check regional weed management.

sources.name: ACT pest plants and animals
sources.what_to_find: Declared pest plants for the ACT.
